title: Introduction to Driving
content: Driving is a skill that requires practice and knowledge of the rules. Start by understanding your vehicle's controls: steering wheel, pedals (accelerator, brake, clutch), and mirrors.

title: Road Positioning
content: Maintaining proper road position is crucial for safety. Always drive in the center of your lane and keep a safe distance from the vehicle in front.

title: Parking Techniques
content: Learn how to parallel park and reverse park safely. Use your mirrors and look over your shoulder to check for obstacles.
